blocks.text: I can identify {hundredths} as part of a whole.
In this lesson you will find out what one hundredth is and how it links to ones and tenths.
Tap each word to see what it means.

items.def: Exactly the same amount or value.
One part of ten equal parts.
One part of one hundred equal parts.

blocks.text: Here is one whole. The whole has been divided into **100 equal parts**.
Each part is one {hundredth} of the whole.
The parts must be **equal**: every part is exactly the same size.
We can show the same whole with base 10 blocks. There are one hundred small blocks again.

blocks.label: How many hundredths make one whole?
blocks.text: One hundred hundredths are equal to **one whole**.
There are {100 hundredths} in one whole.
Start with one whole. Divide it into **ten equal parts**. Each part is one {tenth}.
Now divide each tenth into **ten equal parts**. Each new part is one {hundredth}.

blocks.label: How many hundredths are in one tenth?
blocks.text: One tenth is equal to **ten hundredths**. In a base 10 block picture, each column is one tenth and each row is one tenth too.
There are {10 hundredths} in one tenth.

blocks.why: There are 10 hundredths in one tenth.

blocks.q: How many hundredths are there in one whole?
blocks.why: The whole is divided into one hundred equal parts, so there are 100 hundredths.

blocks.q: A whole is divided into ten equal parts. Each part is one …
blocks.why: One part of ten equal parts is a tenth.

blocks.text: Hundredths are not only squares. Here is a number line that shows **one metre**, from 0 m to 1 m.
The whole (one metre) has been divided into one hundred equal parts. Each part is {one hundredth of a metre}.
You can find hundredths on a line as well as in a square.
Hundredths can be found in lots of different contexts. What is the whole this time?

items.title: one whole {litre}
items.sub: each of 100 equal parts is one hundredth of a litre

items.title: one whole {kilogram} of rice
items.sub: one tenth of a kilogram, then one hundredth of a kilogram

blocks.label: Which is the smallest amount of rice?
blocks.text: One hundredth of a kilogram. One whole kilogram is the biggest, one tenth is smaller, and one hundredth is smaller still.

items.q: A litre of water is divided into 100 equal parts. Each part is one … of a litre.
A metre is divided into ten equal parts. Each part is one … of a metre.
One tenth of a kilogram is divided into ten equal parts. Each part is one … of a kilogram.

blocks.text: The whole has been divided into 100 equal parts. If **two parts** are shaded, that is {two hundredths} of the whole.
It does not matter where the two parts are placed. It is still two hundredths.
If **ten parts** are shaded, that is {ten hundredths}.

blocks.label: How else could we describe ten hundredths?
blocks.text: Ten hundredths is the same as **one tenth**.
Twenty four parts out of 100 are shaded. That is {24 hundredths}. Is there another way to say it?

items: Ten hundredths is one tenth. So twenty hundredths is two tenths.
So 24 hundredths is **two tenths and four hundredths**.

blocks.text: Here is another. Three tenths is the same as 30 hundredths. So one hundredth less than three tenths is **29 hundredths**.

blocks.label: Watch out!
blocks.text: Hundredths do not only live in a square. 29 hundredths is still 29 hundredths on a number line, in a jug of water or in a bag of rice.

blocks.q: Is each amount the same as 30 hundredths? Tap an amount, then tap its column.
Match each amount to the number of hundredths.
Pick the number that completes each sentence.

items: When a whole is divided into one hundred equal parts, each part is one **hundredth**.
Ten hundredths are equal to one **tenth**.
One hundred hundredths are equal to one **whole**.
If you shade more than one hundredth, you have multiple hundredths of the whole, and it does not matter where they are placed.

blocks.text: You can find {hundredths} of a square, a metre, a litre or a kilogram.

flashcards.back: Exactly the same amount or value.
One part of one hundred equal parts.
One part of ten equal parts.

flashcards.front: How many hundredths are there in one whole?
How many hundredths are there in one tenth?
flashcards.back:
10 hundredths.

Ten hundredths is equal to one tenth.

flashcards.front: How do you make hundredths from a whole?
flashcards.back: Cut the whole into ten equal parts (tenths). Then cut each tenth into ten equal parts (hundredths).

flashcards.front: A metre is divided into 100 equal parts. What is each part?
Two parts out of 100 equal parts are shaded. Does it matter where they are?
flashcards.back: No. It is still two hundredths.

flashcards.front: How many hundredths are the same as 3 tenths?
flashcards.back:
30 hundredths.

Ten hundredths is one tenth, so 3 tenths is 30 hundredths.

flashcards.front: Say 24 hundredths as tenths and hundredths.
What is one hundredth less than 3 tenths?
In a base 10 block picture of one whole, what does each column stand for?
flashcards.back:
One tenth of the whole.

Each column is ten hundredths.

worksheet.title: Worksheet: Identify hundredths as part of a whole
worksheet.instructions: Answer each question with a number or a short word. Use what you know: there are 10 hundredths in one tenth and 100 hundredths in one whole.

questions.prompt: How many hundredths are there in one whole?
questions.explanation: The whole is divided into one hundred equal parts, so there are 100 hundredths.

questions.prompt: How many hundredths are there in one tenth?
questions.explanation: Each tenth is divided into ten equal parts, so one tenth is ten hundredths.

questions.prompt: A litre of water is divided into 100 equal parts. What is each part called? (Write one word.)
questions.explanation: One part of one hundred equal parts is a hundredth.
Each tenth is 10 hundredths, so 3 tenths is 3 × 10 = 30 hundredths.
Each tenth is 10 hundredths, so 6 tenths is 6 × 10 = 60 hundredths.

questions.prompt: What is one hundredth less than 3 tenths? Write your answer as a number of hundredths.
questions.explanation: 3 tenths is 30 hundredths, and one hundredth less is 29 hundredths.

questions.prompt: How many tenths are the same as 100 hundredths?
questions.explanation: There are 10 hundredths in one tenth, and 100 ÷ 10 = 10, so 100 hundredths is 10 tenths (one whole).
